mechanism: Valbenazine is metabolized by CYP3A4 and sitagliptin may have minor CYP3A4 inhibitory effects, potentially increasing valbenazine exposure; additive risk of QT prolongation and CNS effects possible.
action: Monitor for increased valbenazine side effects (akathisia, parkinsonism, QT prolongation); consider ECG monitoring and dose adjustment if adverse effects emerge.
